# Output columns

Schema version **1.0**. One row per input polygon. Angles are in degrees, lengths in metres. Azimuth is clockwise from true north.

| Column | Type | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `polygon_id` | string |  | Unique row id. Exploded MultiPolygon parts get a __p<i> suffix. |
| `parent_polygon_id` | string |  | Id of the input feature this row came from; equals polygon_id unless the row is an exploded MultiPolygon part. |
| `input_row` | int32 |  | 0-based row position of the parent feature in the input polygon file. A join key that works even when the input has no id column. |
| `status` | string |  | What happened to this polygon: measured, no_fit, no_lidar_tile, outside_tile_index, tile_unreadable or invalid_geometry. Every input polygon has exactly one row. |
| `geometry` | binary |  | Polygon footprint (WKB) in the run CRS. Null only when the input feature had no geometry. |
| `area_m2` | float | m2 | Plan-view (horizontal) area of the polygon. |
| `surface_area_m2` | float | m2 | Area along the fitted plane: area_m2 / cos(tilt). Null without a fit. |
| `aspect_ratio` | float |  | Long/short side of the minimum rotated rectangle. |
| `polygon_vintage` | date32[day] | date | Capture date of the imagery the polygon was derived from (latest day of the declared window). |
| `installed_by` | date32[day] | date | Date by which the installation is known to have been complete, from the polygon layer (vintage.installed_by_column). Null when not supplied. |
| `not_installed_before` | date32[day] | date | Date before which the installation is known not to have existed, from the polygon layer (vintage.not_installed_before_column). Null when not supplied. |
| `lidar_date` | date32[day] | date | LiDAR capture date for this row's tile: declared, or measured from per-point GPS time. |
| `lidar_date_source` | string |  | Where lidar_date came from: declared, gps_time (measured flight date) or header_date (LAS header; a delivery date, can lag the flight). |
| `vintage_gap_days` | int32 | days | polygon_vintage minus lidar_date. Positive means the polygon is newer than the LiDAR, so the installation may be absent from it. |
| `recommended` | bool |  | True for rows suggested for analysis of array geometry: measured, on a panel basis (panel_confirmed, panel_by_install_date, panel_by_vintage or free_standing) and free of the flags that mark an unreliable or double-counted row. PROVISIONAL rule, to be fixed once accuracy is validated; see RECOMMENDED_RULE in the dataset metadata. |
| `geometry_basis` | string |  | What the fitted plane represents: panel_confirmed, panel_by_install_date, panel_by_vintage, free_standing, surface_unresolved, surface_before_install, unscreened, no_fit, or not_measured when the polygon never reached the LiDAR. |
| `n_points` | int32 |  | LiDAR returns inside the (eroded) polygon. Null when not measured. |
| `n_inliers` | int32 |  | Returns within the RANSAC threshold of the fitted plane. |
| `fit_failure` | string |  | Why there is no fit, when status is no_fit: too_few_points, ground_level_only or no_consensus. |
| `point_density` | float | pts/m2 | n_points / area_m2. |
| `tilt_deg` | float | deg | Tilt of the fitted plane from horizontal (0 = flat). |
| `azimuth_deg` | float | deg | Direction the plane faces, clockwise from TRUE north (0 = N, 90 = E, 180 = S). Null below the tilt floor, where it is undefined. |
| `grid_convergence_deg` | float | deg | Meridian convergence at the polygon: the true-north bearing of the run CRS's grid north. Already added to every azimuth column; subtract it to get the azimuth relative to grid north. |
| `fit_rmse_m` | float | m | Perpendicular RMSE of the inliers about the fitted plane. |
| `fit_tolerance_m` | float | m | RANSAC inlier distance the accepted fit used. Larger than the configured base when the returns were too noisy for it. |
| `fit_rival_share` | float |  | Support for the strongest different plane found in the same returns, as a share of the fitted plane's inliers. Near 1 means two planes fit about equally well and the reported one is a fragile choice. Null if none was found. |
| `fit_rival_angle_deg` | float | deg | Angle between the fitted plane and that rival plane. |
| `tilt_unc_deg` | float | deg | Bootstrap 1-sigma uncertainty of the tilt. |
| `azimuth_unc_deg` | float | deg | Bootstrap circular 1-sigma uncertainty of the azimuth. |
| `n_facets` | int8 |  | Number of distinct facets (planes) in the polygon; 0 without a fit. The tilt_deg, azimuth_deg and the fit_* columns describe the primary (largest) facet; `facets` holds all. |
| `secondary_tilt_deg` | float | deg | Tilt of the second plane, when one was found. |
| `secondary_azimuth_deg` | float | deg | Azimuth of the second plane (true north), when one was found. |
| `facets` | list of records (see Facets below) |  | Every facet of the polygon, primary first: one entry for an ordinary array, several when the polygon covers more than one roof face. Each has its own tilt, true-north azimuth, area share and uncertainty. Null without a fit. Exported flat as pv_geom_facets in the release dataset. |
| `roof_ref_source` | string |  | How the roof reference ring was built: footprint_ring (clipped to a building footprint), open_ring (no footprint) or none. |
| `open_ground_share` | float |  | Ground returns as a share of all returns in a 2 m band around the polygon: near 0 around an array on a roof, near 1 around a ground mount or canopy. Null where the band is too thinly sampled. Feeds the free_standing basis. |
| `roof_ref_method` | string |  | How the roof plane was chosen within the ring: dominant_plane (the ring's main plane), collar_facet (the facet the band beside the array lies on), panel_parallel_facet (the facet parallel to the array plane, where that band is split between facets) or collar_only. Null without a usable roof reference. |
| `roof_tilt_deg` | float | deg | Tilt of the plane fitted to the ring around the polygon. |
| `roof_azimuth_deg` | float | deg | Azimuth of the plane fitted to the ring around the polygon (true north). |
| `roof_rmse_m` | float | m | RMSE of the roof-ring fit. |
| `angle_to_roof_deg` | float | deg | Angle between the panel and roof planes. Null without a usable roof fit. |
| `height_above_roof_m` | float | m | Vertical offset of the panel plane above the roof plane. Null without a usable roof fit. |
| `height_above_ground_m` | float | m | Median panel height above nearby ground returns. Null when no ground reference exists nearby. |
| `on_building` | bool |  | Polygon overlaps a building footprint. Null when the run had no footprint layer. |
| `building_id` | string |  | Id of the overlapped footprint, when there is one. |
| `flags` | list of string |  | Quality flags; see QUALITY_FLAGS. |
| `lidar_tile_ids` | list of string |  | LiDAR tiles read for this row's tile group. |
| `pkg_version` | string |  | pv-geom version. |
| `config_hash` | string |  | sha256 of the resolved run configuration. |
| `run_id` | string |  | Run identifier. |
| `partition_id` | int32 |  | Output partition. |

## Facets

Each entry of the `facets` column, and each row of `pv_geom_facets` in the release dataset, has these fields.

| Field | Type | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `facet_index` | int8 |  | 0 for the primary (largest) facet, then by size. |
| `area_share` | float |  | Share of the polygon's fitted returns on this facet. |
| `area_m2` | float | m2 | Plan area apportioned to the facet: polygon area x share. |
| `surface_area_m2` | float | m2 | Area along the facet's plane: area_m2 / cos(tilt). |
| `tilt_deg` | float | deg | Tilt of the facet from horizontal. |
| `azimuth_deg` | float | deg | Direction the facet faces, clockwise from true north; null below the tilt floor. |
| `fit_rmse_m` | float | m | RMSE of the facet's returns about its plane. |
| `tilt_unc_deg` | float | deg | Bootstrap 1-sigma uncertainty of the tilt. |
| `azimuth_unc_deg` | float | deg | Bootstrap 1-sigma uncertainty of the azimuth. |
| `n_points` | int32 |  | LiDAR returns on the facet. |
| `height_above_ground_m` | float | m | Median height of the facet above ground. |
| `geometry` | binary |  | Where in the polygon the facet lies (WKB, run CRS). |

## Names before schema 0.6

Outputs written under these names are renamed as they are read. `pv_geom.load(output, legacy_names=True)` adds them back for one release.

| Was | Is |
| --- | --- |
| `panel_tilt_deg` | `tilt_deg` |
| `panel_azimuth_deg` | `azimuth_deg` |
| `panel_tilt_unc_deg` | `tilt_unc_deg` |
| `panel_azimuth_unc_deg` | `azimuth_unc_deg` |
| `panel_rmse_m` | `fit_rmse_m` |
| `panel_fit_tolerance_m` | `fit_tolerance_m` |
| `panel_rival_share` | `fit_rival_share` |
| `panel_rival_angle_deg` | `fit_rival_angle_deg` |
| `n_points_panel` | `n_points` |
| `n_inliers_panel` | `n_inliers` |
| `panel_roof_angle_deg` | `angle_to_roof_deg` |
| `n_planes_detected` | `n_facets` |
| `segments` | `facets` |
